specs.direction: MONOLITHIC RELIEF LETTERING. Create thick low-wide geometric SANS-SERIF capitals, unusually substantial and tightly composed. Squared-off stems, blunt chamfer corners, straight horizontal cuts and deep cut-out counters. A flat-topped geometric A with a strong crossbar; a blocky S; flat T arms; squared E and L. Every letter feels carved in relief from pale silver stone with polished metal edges, with tiny amethyst seams IN the carved recesses. Frontal view, broad matte planes and small crisp silver bevels, just enough extrusion to cast violet internal shadows. A slightly staggered stone relief silhouette, ancient and imposing. NO thin stems, NO classical triangular serif feet, NO supporting plaque or background slab: the individual chunky letters themselves make the monument. No central emblem. This must read as a heavy sculptural word shape rather than the usual elegant serif title.

specs.direction: FLUID HAND-LETTERED RIBBON. Draw ASTELLA as original highly legible forward-leaning capital calligraphy, with the energy of one swift handwritten silver ribbon. Not a conventional upright font. Long diagonal movement, smoothly changing stroke widths, open counters and confident tapered terminals. A and final A are calligraphic gestures, S a flowing sweep, T a short angled cross-stroke, E an open rounded calligraphic form, two distinct L strokes. Keep all seven letters readable in order. Give the brush-ribbon bodies softly sculpted pale silver faces and amethyst-enamel side surfaces, small pearly highlights and dark-violet edge definition. Light, nimble, lyrical and asymmetrical; slight upward flow, entirely different from block lettering. At most one short graceful flourish integrated into a letter, not an ornamental underline or orbit. No separate jewel or badge. No excessive wispy loops that obscure spelling.

specs.direction: TALL CONDENSED NEEDLE LETTERING. Build a striking, vertically stretched and narrowly spaced original alphabet, elegant and severe, like precision-cut silver enamel instruments. Very tall thin vertical stems; small clipped geometric terminals, tight rectangular counters; restrained art-deco rhythm. The A has a high narrow triangular counter; S is compressed and angular; T has very short arms; E and the two Ls form repeated vertical pillars. Seven clearly distinct uppercase letters ASTELLA, one horizontal line, compact overall width with noticeably tall proportions. Solid ivory-silver flat fronts, charcoal-indigo recessed edge, a hairline amethyst inlay that runs through selected vertical cuts. Small engraved notches integrated into strokes suggest frozen time without drawing a clock. Deep enough narrow side facets to feel sculptural and refined, not flat text. No Roman serif feet, no wide chubby letters, no bottom jewel or separate architectural frame.

specs.name: 은목의 결
specs.direction: LIVING SILVERWOOD LETTERFORMS. Shape the readable seven-letter word ASTELLA from sculptural silver-barked branches and carved organic wood-grain strokes. The letter shapes themselves grow and twist: forked A stems, a gentle twisted S trunk, branched T and E arms, two clear upright Ls, and a final forked A. Broad readable light faces are carved smooth while their sides show elegant silver grain and deep violet heartwood. This is not an ordinary serif font wearing leaf ornaments. The natural structure defines the alphabet; uneven handcrafted top/bottom edges, a few small angular amethyst growths embedded INSIDE grain. Slightly asymmetrical, organic, inviting, tied to a violet woodland sanctuary. Keep the palette pewter-silver and lavender, no brown bark or green vines. At most two tiny lilac buds attached to stroke ends, not a wreath. No detached jewel, underline, halo, crown or surrounding scene.

specs.direction: PURE CUT-GLASS CRYSTAL ALPHABET. Design ASTELLA as seven chunky modern angular uppercase letters cut entirely from translucent amethyst and clear lavender optical crystal. This is NOT silver metal with a small gem attached. The letters themselves are the crystal: broad solid readable strokes, bevel-cut straight terminals, geometric rectangular E and Ls, a split-facet S, triangular open-counter A. No conventional serif flares. Facets produce pearl-white edge reflections, deep lavender side planes, a few subtle visible internal fractures and restrained violet refraction. High-end painted 3D crystal art with structural clarity and dark indigo defining edges; no neon glow, no rainbow colours. The seven letter bodies form a crisp compact word; there are no isolated floating fragments or decorative rail below. It should look like a completely different identity from metallic classical serif logos while still belonging to the silver/violet Prism palette.
